import java.util.Scanner;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.util.ArrayList;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        final BigInteger MOD = BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007L);
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = scanner.nextInt();
        int k = scanner.nextInt();
        scanner.close();

        BigInteger bigP = BigInteger.valueOf(p);
        BigInteger bigK = BigInteger.valueOf(k);

        if (k == 0) {
            BigInteger exponent = bigP.subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
            BigInteger result = bigP.modPow(exponent, MOD);
            System.out.println(result);
        } else if (k == 1) {
            BigInteger result = bigP.modPow(bigP, MOD);
            System.out.println(result);
        } else {
            ArrayList<BigInteger> z = new ArrayList<>();
            z.add(BigInteger.ONE);
            BigInteger first = z.get(0);
            while (true) {
                BigInteger last = z.get(z.size() - 1);
                BigInteger next = last.multiply(bigK).mod(bigP);
                if (next.equals(first)) {
                    break;
                }
                z.add(next);
            }
            int len = z.size();
            BigInteger exponent = BigInteger.valueOf(p - 1).divide(BigInteger.valueOf(len));
            BigInteger result = bigP.modPow(exponent, MOD);
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }
}
